template_data.headline_html: Five things to know before your first teaming agreement.

items.title: Prime covers the past performance gap
items.sub: Their federal record stands in for the history you haven't built yet

items.title: You bring the specialized capability
items.sub: Skills, pricing, and capacity are your side of the arrangement

items.title: Sub work builds your own past performance
items.sub: Agencies recognize subcontract history — it compounds into your next bid

items.title: You don't need a Schedule before subbing
items.sub: Start as a sub while your own GSA application is still in progress

items.title: Primes are findable through public data
items.sub: SAM.gov awards and sources sought notices show who's hiring in your space
